verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document a sanctioned third-party rail such as designees, authorized filers, registered agents, or representatives acting for a company. The closest items are adjacent: one Online Account can process filings on multiple entities, and the Department of Revenue page has a bare link to 'resources for tax professionals and software providers.' Neither establishes a documented delegated-authority mechanism.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
